params.headline: Ready to launch your private label supplement line?

items.answer: Williston, Vermont. We have operated from Vermont since 1976 and have been steadily expanding the facility over the past five decades to add manufacturing lines, quality lab, and warehousing capacity.
items.question: Where is your manufacturing facility?

items.answer: Capsules (vegetarian and gelatin), tablets, soft gels, powders, chewables, liquids, gummies, and oral sprays. Most formats run on dedicated lines so cross-contamination risk is minimized. Some specialty formats use shared lines with rigorous cleaning protocols between runs.
items.question: What formats do you manufacture on-site?

items.answer: We produce millions of bottles annually across all formats. We can scale production for high-volume programs while maintaining quality. For very high-volume orders (mid-six-figures and up), we plan production scheduling with you in advance to ensure capacity.
items.question: What is your production capacity?

items.answer: Yes. We can hold finished goods inventory in our climate-controlled warehouse for ongoing fulfillment programs. Storage fees apply for extended holds. Most clients have us produce inventory in larger production runs and ship to their own fulfillment partner.
items.question: Do you store finished goods inventory for clients?

items.answer: Yes. We host facility tours for prospective and active clients. Tours typically include the manufacturing floor, quality lab, and warehouse. Schedule a tour through your account manager. Tours are most valuable once you have a specific program scoped because we can show you the lines that will produce your products.
